policies.title: Canada and United States ordinary passports: online approval followed by arrival issuance
policies.summary: The live PAF selector places Canada and the United States in a separate visitor panel but uses the same online approval and arrival-issuance procedure. It is normalized as eta for the same reason as the normal PAF cohort.
conditions: The selector's separate panel labels this route as not exceeding five years, but does not state whether that is visa validity or permitted visitor stay; no short-stay ceiling is asserted here.

The PAF procedure still requires the approved Entry Visa Letter before travel and directs the traveller to the visa-on-arrival counter for issuance and biometrics. Passport validity, funds, onward ticket, accommodation, health, security and admission requirements remain applicable.
This policy does not establish work, residence, business-only, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service or special-document treatment.

application.label: Guinea Border Police online entry-visa approval
steps: Select the travel-document issuing authority and the visitor category in the official PAF service.
Complete the online application and wait for the approved Entry Visa Letter before travel.
Present that letter at the visa-on-arrival counter, where the PAF procedure says the visa is issued after photograph and fingerprints.

policies.title: Guyana: Foreign Ministry and ISS aligned ordinary passports visa-free
policies.summary: The Foreign Ministry and Immigration Support Services schedules both directly name these nationalities without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. This is a visa exemption, not a CARICOM application, landing permit, eVisa or visa-on-arrival route.
conditions: Only nationalities expressly named for ordinary passports or without a passport-type restriction in both schedules are included.

The Foreign Ministry describes CARICOM movement in its schedule, but this policy relies on the same page’s express heading that the named nationals do not require visas; it does not convert treaty movement language, CSME rights, a landing permit or a border form into a visa status.
The two current schedules state different durations for some shared nationalities, including the Dominican Republic and Panama. The classification is visa-free, but no uniform duration is assigned.

Cuba, Indonesia, Spain and Uruguay are not included because the Foreign Ministry limits their exemption to specified diplomatic, official, service or special passports while the ISS schedule presents an unqualified ordinary-passport entry.

policies.title: Guyana: Foreign Ministry named ordinary passports visa-free
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry schedule directly names these nationalities without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. The ISS schedule does not name them, which is not treated as a contrary rule.
conditions: Only the Foreign Ministry's explicit ordinary-passport or unqualified entries are classified. ISS omission is not converted into a visa requirement or a conflicting status.
The classification does not convert CARICOM movement language, an application form, or a third-country-document condition into a visa exemption.

policies.title: Guyana: ISS and consular Schedule 1 named ordinary passports visa-free
policies.summary: The ISS schedule and the official consular Schedule 1 directly name Lesotho and Malaysia without a special-passport or third-country-document condition. The Foreign Ministry schedule does not name them, which is not treated as a contrary rule.
conditions: Only the two explicit unqualified entries are classified; Foreign Ministry omission is not converted into a visa requirement or a conflicting status.
The ISS schedule gives Lesotho 14 days and Malaysia 60 days; no broader duration, passport type or purpose is inferred.

policies.title: Guyana: Bolivian ordinary passport tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs ISS schedule expressly identifies a tourist visa on arrival for Bolivian regular-passport holders. This is visa_on_arrival, not a visa-free or electronic route.
conditions: The stated route is limited to tourist entry with a regular passport. It does not establish a work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document route.

The Foreign Ministry separately identifies a no-visa exemption only for Bolivian diplomatic, service and official passport holders; that passport-type distinction does not contradict the ISS ordinary-passport arrival-visa route.
No fee, duration, ports, entry count, extension or pre-travel approval condition is assigned because this schedule does not state it.

policies.title: Honduras: CA-4 national ordinary-passport entry
policies.summary: INM’s current visitor page directly says nationals of Guatemala, Nicaragua and El Salvador may enter Honduras under the Central American Free Movement Agreement using their national identity document or passport. This establishes a visa-free CA-4 national route, not an electronic or arrival-visa route.
conditions: The current INM page permits a passport or the stated national identity document for these CA-4 nationals; this candidate records only the ordinary-passport baseline.
The source does not set a nationality-wide visitor duration, extension, fee, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule for this policy; none is inferred.
The migration regulation requires use of an authorized port and submission to migration control. Individual admissibility, security, health and entry conditions remain applicable.
Residence, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Bolivian ordinary passports visa-free for tourism or visits
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular states that Honduras removed both the visa and entry-authorisation requirement for Bolivian holders of ordinary passports travelling for tourism or visits. This is visa-free access, not an ETA, eVisa or arrival-visa route.
conditions: Applies to Bolivian ordinary passports for tourism or visits only.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Saudi Arabian ordinary passports Category A visa-free
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular moved Saudi Arabian ordinary passports from Category B to Category A without exception. Category A is Honduras’s visa-exempt classification, so the ordinary-passport baseline is visa-free rather than electronic or arrival-issued.
conditions: The circular expressly includes ordinary passports and says the category change is without exception.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: United Kingdom ordinary passports require an advance consular visa
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 ordinary United Kingdom nationality rule requires a consular visa. The current standard-passport baseline is therefore visa_required, not an ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival; the later circular provides only condition-specific exceptions.
conditions: This records the nationality-wide ordinary United Kingdom passport baseline.
The later visa-free exception for United Kingdom nationals domiciled in the Cayman Islands is conditional and is not representable by the standard GB passport code.

The narrow cruise-passenger exception requires a British passport bearing the stated British-nationality notation and applies only during time in Honduran ports; it does not establish a Hong Kong SAR ordinary-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Jordanian ordinary passports Category B consular visa
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular assigns Jordanian ordinary passports Category B, visa consular. The ordinary-passport baseline is therefore an advance visa_required route, not an ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: The Category A treatment in the same circular is limited to Jordanian diplomatic, official and service passports and does not apply to this policy.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Palestinian ordinary passports Category B consular visa
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular assigns Palestinian ordinary passports Category B, visa consular. The ordinary-passport baseline is therefore an advance visa_required route, not an ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: The Category A treatment in the same circular is limited to Palestinian diplomatic, official and service passports and does not apply to this policy.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: India: Indian citizens
policies.summary: Indian ordinary-passport holders are Indian citizens, not foreigners subject to the foreigner-visa rules.
conditions: Citizenship status only; it is not a finding about an overseas-citizenship card or a foreign passport held by a former Indian citizen.
Does not decide passport issuance, exit controls, dual-nationality questions, residence, work, transit, or admissibility.

policies.title: India: Nepalese and Bhutanese ordinary passports exempt on stated routes
policies.summary: The 2025 Exemption Order exempts Nepalese and Bhutanese citizens from the passport/visa requirement on their own-border routes, and on other stated routes when holding a valid passport.
conditions: The order covers entry by land or air over the Nepal or Bhutan border.
For entry from or to another place, the person must possess a valid passport; the order excludes travel from China, Macao, Hong Kong, or Pakistan from that limb.
Ordinary-passport nationality result only; do not generalize to diplomatic, official, service, transit, crew, residence, employment, security, protected-area, or case-specific admission.

policies.title: India: Maldivian ordinary passports exempt for short visits
policies.summary: India's current bilateral-relations brief describes bilateral visa-free tourism, medical and business entry for Maldives nationals for up to 90 days in the preceding six months.
conditions: For tourism, medical, and business purposes only; stay may not exceed 90 days in the preceding six months.
Valid passport/travel document and other applicable entry, security, health, admission, registration, protected-area, transit, crew, residence, work, and document rules remain applicable.
The separate diplomatic/official-passport waiver is outside this ordinary-passport policy.

policies.title: India: Japanese and South Korean ordinary passports eligible for visa on arrival
policies.summary: India Visa Online identifies Japanese and South Korean nationals for visa on arrival at six designated international airports.
conditions: Visitor must be visiting for no more than 60 days for business, tourism, conference, or medical purposes and meet the stated passport, funds, onward-ticket, admissibility, and other conditions.
Available only at Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and Mumbai international airports; it is non-extendable and non-convertible.
Not available to diplomatic/official-passport holders or persons of Pakistani origin (including the stated parent/grandparent or permanent-residence condition).
The UAE visa-on-arrival route is conditional on an earlier Indian eVisa or regular/paper visa and is therefore not a nationality-wide VOA classification; UAE remains in the eVisa policy.

application.label: India Visa Online: Visa on Arrival
steps: Complete the visa-on-arrival application and disembarkation form before or on arrival.
Present at a designated airport visa counter with the required passport, travel and financial evidence.
Pay the listed fee before the visa is granted.

policies.title: India: ordinary passports eligible for eVisa
policies.summary: The Bureau of Immigration's live eVisa portal lists these passport nationalities as eVisa-eligible; Japan and South Korea are kept in the easier visa-on-arrival policy.
conditions: Apply online, pay the eVisa fee, receive a granted ETA by email, print it, and present it at an eVisa-designated immigration check post.
For e-Tourist/e-Business applications, the portal says to apply at least four days before travel; an approved ETA is required before travelling.
Passport must generally have at least six months' validity; traveller needs onward/return travel and sufficient funds. Biometrics are captured on arrival.
eVisa is not available to diplomatic/official passports, laissez-passer or other non-passport travel documents, or persons endorsed on another person's passport.
Pakistani-passport holders or persons of Pakistani origin must apply for a regular visa at an Indian mission; this overrides nationality-list eligibility where applicable.

eVisa is non-extendable/non-convertible and not valid for protected, restricted, or cantonment areas without prior permission. It does not decide work, residence, transit outside the chosen eVisa category, crew, security, or admissibility.

application.label: India eVisa application
steps: Apply online and upload the required passport page, photograph, and category-specific documents.
Pay the country/territory-specific eVisa fee online.
Await a granted electronic travel authorization, then print it and present it at an eligible immigration check post.

policies.title: India: Afghan ordinary passports require an advance visa
policies.summary: India's central gateway routes Afghanistan nationals to a separate advance AFGHAN Visa service, whose published categories do not establish a standard e-Tourist visa.
conditions: The special portal publishes business, student, medical, medical-attendant, entry, and UN-diplomat services; it does not publish a standard e-Tourist category.
Its online form/ETA workflow is a special advance visa process, not evidence of the general eVisa route.

Purpose-specific documentation, prior authorization, security screening, passport validity, biometrics, registration, protected-area, transit, crew, residence, work, and admissibility conditions remain outside this nationality-only classification.

application.label: India AFGHAN Visa service
steps: Select the applicable published visa service and submit the online application.
Upload the passport bio page, national identity card, and purpose-specific documentation.
Wait for the visa/ETA decision before travelling.

policies.title: India: Pakistani ordinary passports require regular visa in advance
policies.summary: India's eVisa portal directs Pakistani-passport holders and persons of Pakistani origin to apply for a regular visa at an Indian mission.
conditions: The eVisa portal says Pakistani-passport holders and persons of Pakistani origin must apply for a regular visa at an Indian mission.

The current official gateway says all existing valid visas issued to Pakistani nationals, except medical, long-term, diplomatic and official visas, stood revoked immediately from 27 April 2025; medical visas were valid only until 29 April 2025. This record does not infer that a new ordinary visitor visa is presently grantable.
This is an advance regular/paper visa route, not eVisa or visa on arrival.
Purpose-specific, security, port, passport, registration, protected-area, transit, crew, residence, work, diplomatic/official-document, and admissibility conditions remain applicable.

application.label: India regular/paper visa application
steps: Complete the online regular-visa form.
Print and sign the form, then submit it with the passport and supporting documents to the appropriate Indian mission or visa application center.
Collect the passport and visa after the mission or center completes processing.

policies.title: India: other non-exempt ordinary passports require a regular visa in advance
policies.summary: Current Immigration and Foreigners Rules require an appropriate valid visa for foreign passports unless an express exemption applies; these nationalities are absent from the current eVisa eligibility list and ordinary-passport exemptions documented here.
conditions: The current rule requires an appropriate valid visa for foreign passport holders unless an express exemption applies; the central portal distinguishes regular/paper visa from limited-category eVisa.
Complete the online regular-visa form, then print/sign it and submit the passport and supporting documents to the relevant Indian mission or visa application center.

Do not use this policy for holders of an OCI/eOCI card, SAARC Visa Exemption/Visa Liberalisation Scheme endorsements, diplomatic/official/service passports, transit, crew, residence, work, protected/restricted-area travel, security or admission exceptions.

application.label: India regular/paper visa application
steps: Complete the online regular-visa application form.
Print and sign the application, then submit it with passport and supporting documents at the relevant Indian mission or visa application center.
Collect the passport and visa after processing.

policies.title: Indonesian nationals: outside foreign visitor visa scope
policies.summary: Indonesia's visitor-visa framework applies to foreigners, not Indonesian citizens.
conditions: This citizenship classification does not establish the document requirements for a particular Indonesian national, dual national, carrier, or border route.
It does not determine treatment when a dual Indonesian national presents another country's ordinary passport.

policies.title: Current BVK ordinary passports: Indonesia visa exemption
policies.summary: The listed ordinary passports are currently eligible for Indonesia's Bebas Visa Kunjungan (BVK) visitor-visa exemption.
conditions: BVK is a genuine visitor-visa exemption, not Visa on Arrival or e-VOA. The current official BVK list is applied alongside the current VOA list; where both facilities list a nationality, this policy uses the more favourable current BVK classification.
BVK authorizes a visitor stay of up to 30 days and is not extendable. Official BVK visitor purposes include tourism, family, and onward transit; it cannot be used for work or journalism.

A valid ordinary passport of at least six months and a return or onward ticket are required. Indonesian Immigration applies the facility at designated immigration checkpoints and retains admissibility discretion.
This policy does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, crew, calling-visa, refugee, alien travel-document, or other special-document treatment.

policies.title: Current VOA ordinary passports: Indonesia Visa on Arrival
policies.summary: The listed ordinary passports are eligible for Indonesia's Visa on Arrival (VOA) visitor route. e-VOA is an optional electronic application and payment channel for the same VOA category.
conditions: The current official list identifies these nationalities as VOA subjects. e-VOA does not change this normalized status to eVisa: Indonesia Immigration expressly describes e-VOA as electronic Visa on Arrival, while VOA remains obtainable and payable on arrival.

The B1 VOA permits one entry, an initial stay of up to 30 days, and one extension up to a total 60 days. It covers tourism, family visits, meetings/incentives/conventions/exhibitions, and onward transit, not work or residence.

e-VOA holders may use only the current specified airports and seaports. Ordinary VOA may instead be obtained at the applicable arrival immigration point; eligibility and facility availability are entry-point dependent.

The usual application materials include a passport valid at least six months and a return/onward ticket. A crew member joining a conveyance has a stated ticket exception. Entry and the stay permit remain subject to immigration assessment.
This policy does not cover calling-visa clearance, diplomatic, official, special, refugee, alien, or residence documents, or another visa purpose.

policies.title: Non-calling ordinary passports: Indonesia C1 electronic tourist visitor visa
policies.summary: For the listed formerly unresolved ordinary passports, the central Directorate's current C1 rule establishes an account-based, pre-travel electronic visitor-visa route without a sponsor. Nationalities affected by either currently published Calling Visa schedule, and Kosovo whose portal mapping was not disclosed, remain unresolved.
conditions: This policy applies only to holders of a national ordinary passport who were unresolved in the promoted Indonesia batch and are absent from both currently published Calling Visa schedules. It does not duplicate BVK, VOA/e-VOA, or Indonesian-citizen policies.

C1 is a single-entry visitor visa for tourism, personal development, tourist-attraction study, cruise travel, selected MICE participation, business discussions/negotiation/site visits, medical-related activities, and the listed non-work activities. It grants an initial stay of up to 60 days, may be extended up to 180 days, and cannot be used to sell goods or services or receive Indonesian work compensation.

The Directorate's C1 page directs applicants to the official eVisa service for account-based application with electronic files; the official portal says an approved visa is downloadable from a link sent by email. This is an available electronic pre-travel route, not a visa on arrival.

The current materials require a passport valid at least six months, recent photograph, and evidence of at least USD 2,000 living expenses; the visa is valid for 90 days after issuance if unused. Admission and any stay permit remain subject to Immigration assessment.

The live eVisa selection page exposes Passport/Country/Region fields but did not disclose individual country results in this review. Recheck the mutable selector before promotion or travel. The central C1 page expressly says no sponsor, but an undated regional C1 page retains sponsor-led template instructions; the central Directorate page is treated as controlling, while this operational inconsistency remains a material risk.

A second official regional schedule currently identifies Cameroon, Guinea and Niger as Calling Visa nationals while the Bontang schedule does not. Those three codes are left unresolved rather than treated as a no-sponsor complement.

application.label: Indonesia Directorate General of Immigration eVisa service
application.processingTime: The C1 page states five working days after payment for Directorate or representative processing.
steps: Use the official eVisa service referenced by the Directorate General of Immigration C1 page to submit the C1 pre-travel application and electronic files.
Provide a national passport valid at least six months, recent photograph, and required evidence of funds; pay the billed C1 fee after the application is accepted.
Wait for the visa decision before travel and present the approved C1 and required travel documents for immigration examination on arrival.

policies.title: Iranian citizenship
policies.summary: An Iranian ordinary passport belongs to an Iranian citizen and is outside the foreign visitor-visa schedule.
conditions: Does not decide dual-national document choice, exit controls, residence, work, military service, or case-specific border treatment.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: 15-day unilateral tourist exemption
policies.summary: The current Iranian MFA eVisa portal lists 27 ordinary-passport nationalities entitled to a unilateral tourism visa exemption.
conditions: Tourism only; the current MFA portal states one non-extendable 15-day stay in each six-month period.

The current portal says some visa types for some nationalities must be applied for in person and some nationalities may not be issued a visa for political or diplomatic reasons; it does not publish a complete passport-code schedule for those exceptions.

This policy does not establish work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, alien-document, group-tour, sponsor, third-country-residence, security, or individual-admission treatment.

policies.title: Nine named foreign citizenships: visa-waiver rules
policies.summary: The current Iranian MFA eVisa portal identifies nine foreign citizenships as subject to Iran’s visa-waiver rules.
conditions: The portal describes these nationalities as subject to visa-waiver rules under internal laws, approvals, and bilateral agreements, but does not publish ordinary-passport stay length, purpose, entry point, passport-type, or recurrence terms.

This is a nationality-wide waiver classification only; it does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency-document, transit, border-crossing, security, or individual-admission treatment.

policies.title: Lebanese, Venezuelan, and Malaysian nationals: permit at designated entry points
policies.summary: The current Iranian MFA eVisa portal says Lebanese, Venezuelan, and Malaysian nationals obtain necessary permits upon entry at designated entry points.
conditions: The portal calls the document a permit rather than a visa, but expressly makes it available upon entry at designated entry points. It is conservatively normalized as visa_on_arrival, not visa_free or eVisa.

Purpose, stay duration, document type, qualifying conditions, ports, security screening, and any prior approval are governed by the portal’s referenced established rules and conditions, which are not published as a code-level schedule.
This does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, emergency-document, transit, sponsor, security, or individual-admission treatment.

policies.title: Iraqi citizenship is outside foreign visitor-visa scope
policies.summary: An Iraqi ordinary passport belongs to an Iraqi citizen, whereas the federal Residence Law defines the visitor-visa regime for foreigners.
conditions: Does not decide a dual national’s document choice, residence, departure, security screening, consular treatment, or treatment when travelling on a foreign passport.

Article 1(Third)(h) separately excludes Iraqis and their children who hold foreign passports; that individual origin/document exception is not converted into a nationality-wide classification for every foreign passport code.

The federal law separately carves out heads of state, diplomatic and consular personnel, crew, authorized ship/plane/train passengers, treaty beneficiaries, minors on relatives’ passports, and neighboring-border residents. Those special-document, route, treaty, and residence facts are outside this ordinary-passport policy.

policies.title: Jamaican nationals: outside foreign visitor-visa scope
policies.summary: PICA's country table governs foreigners and Commonwealth nationals entering Jamaica, not Jamaican nationals.
conditions: This citizenship classification does not establish a particular traveller's document, carrier, dual-nationality, departure, residence, or admissibility treatment.
It must not be read as resolving entry when a dual Jamaican national presents another country's ordinary passport.

policies.title: PICA-listed ordinary passports: visa exemption for a short visit
policies.summary: PICA's live country table expressly marks these ordinary-nationality cohorts as not requiring a visa for entry to Jamaica; the stated duration and permitted short-visit purpose vary by row.
conditions: This is a nationality-specific ordinary short-visit exemption, not a finding that every PICA-listed document is visa-free. The exact table rows set differing stays and purposes: many state 30 or 90 days, the United States row states six months, and China and Macao are tourism-only examples.

PICA attaches health-document conditions to Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovenia, and attaches yellow-fever proof conditions to Bolivia, Paraguay and Peru. Those document conditions remain applicable and do not change the normalized visa-free status.

The specific Dominican Republic and Ireland rows also cover ordinary, diplomatic and official passports for stated tourism, business, cultural, transit, official, or diplomatic purposes. This policy only models the ordinary-passport short-visitor part of those rows.

A visa exemption neither authorizes work, residence, study, crew duties, nor overrides any purpose-specific requirement. It does not establish treatment of diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, alien, certificate-of-identity, laissez-passer, military, seaman, or other non-ordinary documents.

MFAFT states that an immigration officer at the port of entry has final authority. Travellers must also use a valid, approved travel document; the embassy guidance adds passport validity for the visit and yellow-fever evidence when travelling from or through a WHO risk country.

policies.title: PICA-listed ordinary passports: visa at port of entry
policies.summary: PICA expressly says that these nationalities require a visa but may obtain it at the port of entry; this is normalized as visa on arrival, not visa-free or eVisa.
conditions: This route is limited to the PICA rows that literally state a visa may be obtained at the port of entry. It is not a general online-visa or prior-approval route.

Taiwan's row requires an Affidavit of Identity in addition to the port-of-entry visa. PICA's page separately says that holders of other accepted non-passport travel documents generally require a visa.

MFAFT says port-of-entry visa applicants must satisfy immigration authorities of their bona fides; its published checklist includes a valid passport, onward or return ticket and sufficient funds/accommodation. Admission remains for the immigration officer to decide.
The policy does not establish diplomatic, official, refugee, alien-document, residence, work, study, crew, transit, or any unlisted-special-document treatment.

policies.title: PICA-listed ordinary passports: visa required before travel
policies.summary: PICA's current country table requires a visa for these ordinary-passport cohorts and does not give them the port-of-entry visa route; the MFAFT-hosted Immigration Unit listing expressly supplies Timor-Leste as PTA.
conditions: For Albania, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Honduras, Kazakhstan, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Romania and Serbia, PICA's country-specific text gives a narrow visa waiver for a tourist stay of 30 days or less only when the traveller holds the named valid United States, Canadian, United Kingdom or Schengen visa, with listed vaccination evidence where required. That is a third-country-document condition, not passport-wide visa-free access or a Jamaican visa on arrival.

policies.title: Macao: non-exempt ordinary passports eligible for border-issued Entry Permit
policies.summary: For these foreign ordinary passports, the current Public Security Police rule supplies an Entry Permit, expressly called visa-upon-arrival, at any border checkpoint; the six expressly advance-visa nationalities and document-specific China/Hong Kong/Macao cases are excluded.
conditions: The Entry Permit is an Authorization to Enter and Stay, explicitly described by the PSP as visa-upon-arrival, requested at any Border Control Department checkpoint. It is classified as visa on arrival, not eVisa or visa-free.

Once approved, the visitor Authorization to Stay is a maximum of 30 days; the current listed individual fee is MOP200 one-off or MOP300 multiple, with stated alternative fees for family passports, children and qualifying groups.

A passport must be valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Onward/return arrangements, means of subsistence, security/admissibility and entry-refusal grounds remain applicable; advance authorization or a Macao visa are alternative procedures, not a nationality-wide electronic route.

This policy excludes Bangladesh, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Vietnam, which the PSP expressly requires to obtain an advance Macao visa; it also does not flatten Mainland China, Hong Kong or Macao passport/document arrangements.

policies.title: Macao: six named ordinary passports requiring advance Macao visa
policies.summary: The current Public Security Police guidance expressly requires visitors from these six countries to obtain a Macao visa in advance through a Chinese embassy or consulate.
conditions: The advance visa is applied for through a Chinese embassy or consulate. The ordinary border Entry Permit route is not available to this named cohort.
The source does not establish an eVisa route, duration, fee, entry count or any work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/service or special-document exception for them.
Passport validity, onward/return arrangements, funds, security/admissibility and entry-refusal conditions still apply at actual entry.

policies.title: Madagascar: short-stay visa on arrival for foreign ordinary passports
policies.summary: Madagascar requires every non-Malagasy nationality to hold a visa but permits the short-stay visa process at international airports and ports, with online pre-application as an optional alternative.
conditions: Ordinary-passport tourism and other eligible non-immigrant short visits only. The reviewed Embassy guidance says every non-Malagasy nationality needs a visa and describes the short-stay visa as available at Madagascar's international airports and ports.

The Ministry of Tourism says a single-entry stay visa may be requested at the arrival airport or online. Because no advance authorisation is necessary when using the arrival route, this policy is normalized as visa on arrival rather than eVisa.

Decree No. 2017-1021 applies the eVisa system to every foreign non-immigrant and permits instructions online or at arrival. An online landing authorisation is not a travel document or a guarantee that the border visa will be granted.

Current consular requirements include a completed form, recent photographs, an ordinary passport valid more than six months after the return date with at least two blank pages, return travel, accommodation, and payment of the applicable visa fee.
Short-stay visas may be extended only within a cumulative 90-day maximum, are not convertible to long-stay status, and do not authorize paid or profit-making activity.
Yellow-fever certification may be required after recent presence in an infected country. Border officers retain admissibility authority.

Does not classify immigration, residence, employment, study exceeding short-stay scope, transit without border clearance, crew, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless or other special-document cases.

application.label: Official eVisa Madagascar delegated-service portal
steps: Choose either the border application route or the optional online process linked by the Ministry of Tourism.
For online pre-application, submit the requested identity, passport, trip and accommodation information and retain the landing authorisation.
At the entry point, present the required original documents, landing authorisation if used, and payment receipt or complete the arrival application and fee payment with immigration officers.

policies.title: Madagascar: citizenship treatment
policies.summary: A Malagasy citizen using an ordinary Madagascar national passport is represented as citizenship rather than foreign visitor admission.
conditions: Represents an ordinary Madagascar national passport holder returning to Madagascar, not the diplomatic, service or foreign visitor categories.
Does not classify dual-nationality, foreign residence, document-validity or case-specific border circumstances.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: The current Government Tourism arrangements expressly designate this ordinary-passport cohort Visa Free. The broader SADC and COMESA wording remains subject to reciprocity, so only the page's explicit named-country outcomes are normalized.
conditions: The Tourism page says visa exemption is subject to reciprocity and may change. This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor classification only, not a finding on work, residence, business-only, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee or other special-document travel.

The page's named Visa-Exempt Countries section includes Dominica although its detailed country grid omits a Dominica row. It is retained as directly named visa-free evidence, but that internal presentation gap is a material review risk.

The official High Commission's dated 2024 79-country waiver announcement names examples that differ from the current 2026 schedules. It is retained as historical reconciliation evidence only, not expanded into a present-day default without a current authoritative bridge.
A visa exemption does not itself state a passport-validity, funds, onward-ticket, accommodation, vaccination, fee, port or stay limit. Immigration admission and security controls remain applicable.

policies.title: Category Two ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The effective 24 February 2026 Department notice and its current Category Two schedule expressly allow this cohort to obtain a visa at designated ports. The portal encourages a pre-departure eVisa but preserves actual border issuance, so the easier supported route is visa_on_arrival, not evisa.
conditions: The public notice permits Category Two nationals to board without a visa and obtain one on arrival at designated ports. It does not enumerate the operating ports, an arrival fee, passport-validity, funds, onward-ticket, accommodation, vaccination, extension or stay limit; do not assume these from the separate electronic-application product.

The official PDF's phrase 'with or without prior authorization' and the portal's encouragement to apply online preserve case-specific pre-authorisation possibilities. They do not defeat the notice's expressly available arrival-issuance baseline, nor make the optional eVisa an ETA.

The notice does not establish ordinary-visitor duration or extension. Work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and special-document routes are excluded; admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Category One ordinary passports: advance electronic visa
policies.summary: The current Category One schedule requires this cohort to obtain a visa well in advance or prior authorization. The Department's live nationality selector offers its Single Entry product for each listed ordinary passport, supporting evisa rather than visa on arrival.
conditions: The source requires a visa well in advance or prior authorization. For every listed code, the live Department selector returned the electronic Single Entry product for an Ordinary Passport; this supports evisa rather than assuming a mission-only route. It does not establish any VOA alternative.

The official eVisa FAQ currently says processing is within three working days and lists electronic single-entry, transit and multiple-entry products. Its listed electronic fees include USD 50 single-entry, USD 50 transit, USD 150 six-month multiple entry and USD 250 12-month multiple entry; recheck products, fees and case processing before travel.

The eVisa is not automatic entry. It does not decide the visitor permit, stay or extension, port, passport-validity, funds, onward-ticket, accommodation, vaccination, work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, special-document, security or individual-admissibility rules.

application.label: Malawi Department of Immigration eVisa portal
application.processingTime: The current official FAQ says applications are processed within three working days; apply before travel because Category One requires a visa or prior authorization before departure.
steps: Create an account and submit the applicable electronic visa application through the Department's eVisa portal.
Complete the portal's payment and provide any supporting documents or further information the Department requests.
Download and print the approved eVisa before travel, then present it for immigration examination and separate entry permission.

policies.title: Malawian citizens: constitutional right to return
policies.summary: The Constitution directly provides a right to return to the Republic, so the Malawi ordinary-passport same-country pair is not classified under a foreign visitor visa route.
conditions: This records only the constitutional return right. It does not determine passport issuance or validity, dual nationality, document screening, health, customs, criminal process, security checks or other border formalities.

policies.title: Malaysian nationals: outside foreign visitor visa scope
policies.summary: Malaysia's foreign visitor-visa and eVisa framework does not classify Malaysian citizens as foreign visa applicants.
conditions: This citizenship classification does not establish the document requirements for a particular Malaysian national, dual national, carrier, or border route.
It does not determine treatment when a dual Malaysian national presents another country's ordinary passport.

policies.title: Ordinary passports outside Malaysia's current visa-required framework: visa-free social visit
policies.summary: The listed ordinary passports are outside the Immigration Department's current visa-required/eVisa nationality framework for a short social visit and are normalized as visa-free visitors.
conditions: This conclusion is limited to an ordinary-passport social visit. The Immigration Department's country table, MYVISA's specified 31-nationality eVisa framework, and the current Ministry of Foreign Affairs country-by-country visa chart together identify the exhaustive ordinary-passport framework; it is not a rule for work, study, residence, media, diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, laissez-passer, certificate-of-identity, or other special travel documents.

Visa-free duration is nationality- and purpose-specific. This policy does not convert ASEAN arrangements, Taiwan's separate stay limit, or other shorter social-visit permissions into a uniform duration.

MDAC is a separate arrival declaration, not a visa, eVisa, ETA, entry permit, or admission guarantee. Subject to current listed exceptions, submit it within three days including the arrival date and present it with the passport to immigration.

Malaysia determines individual admissibility and issues the appropriate pass at immigration control. A person prohibited under section 8 may be refused despite a valid travel document, visa, ticket, and funds.

Social/business visits are distinct from other pass types, which must generally be applied for before entry. The visitor may not take unauthorised employment, attend school, or undertake other activity outside the authorized pass.

policies.title: China and Myanmar ordinary passports: current special social-visit exemptions
policies.summary: Malaysia's current official guidance separately exempts Chinese and Myanmar ordinary passports from the otherwise visa-required/eVisa social-visit framework, subject to their stated nationality-specific periods and conditions.
conditions: Chinese citizens holding an ordinary passport valid for at least six months are exempt for social visits of up to 30 days per entry for tourism, business, or family visit, with no more than 90 days in any 180-day period. The source excludes a Chinese multiple-entry-visa route from that exemption.
Myanmar ordinary passport holders travelling for a social visit are visa-free for up to 14 days from 1 October 2025 under the current MYVISA FAQ.

These are ordinary-passport social-visit rules, not a rule for diplomatic, official, public-affairs, residence, work, study, long-term, transit, or special travel-document routes. MDAC remains a separate arrival declaration and admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: temporary social-visit exemption through 31 December 2026
policies.summary: Malaysia's current official guidance temporarily exempts Indian ordinary-passport holders from the otherwise visa-required/eVisa social-visit framework through 31 December 2026.
conditions: The social-visit single-entry exemption is expressly temporary through 31 December 2026. It does not establish an exemption for a different purpose or period after that date.

This is an ordinary-passport social-visit rule, not a rule for diplomatic, official, public-affairs, residence, work, study, long-term, transit, or special travel-document routes. MDAC remains a separate arrival declaration and admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Listed ordinary passports: Malaysia social-visit eVisa
policies.summary: For the listed ordinary passport nationalities, Malaysia's current MYVISA framework requires a pre-travel eVisa for a social visit, rather than treating the online application as an ETA or ordinary visa-free entry.
conditions: MYVISA identifies eVisa as an electronic visa, not an ETA, and says the single-entry social-visit eVisa is compulsory for the specified nationalities. It is only for social visits such as tourism, family visits, or short business trips.

The ordinary eVisa single-entry route must be obtained before travel. MYVISA says a single-entry eVisa permits one journey within six months of issue, subject to passport validity; neither eVisa nor MDAC guarantees entry.
Afghan ordinary passport holders must first obtain VDR approval before applying for eVisa. The source's diplomatic and official passport exception is not represented by this ordinary-passport policy.

For the specifically named African nationalities in MYVISA's air-only list, entry with eVisa is limited to air entry points. This does not create a general air-only rule for every nationality in this policy.

MDAC remains a separate arrival declaration. Work, study, residence, media, professional/temporary employment, medical treatment and other VDR purposes follow separate advance procedures and are not granted by this social-visit eVisa.

application.label: MYVISA Malaysia eVisa
steps: Apply through the MYVISA official portal before travelling for the eligible social visit.
For Afghanistan, obtain the required VDR approval before the eVisa application.
Present the approved eVisa, passport, MDAC, and supporting entry documents for Malaysian immigration assessment.

policies.title: Israel and North Korea ordinary passports: special advance visa handling
policies.summary: Israeli and North Korean ordinary passports are not within Malaysia's online eVisa application availability and require the applicable special advance visa/approval handling.
conditions: Malaysia's official eVisa guidance excludes applications from Israel and North Korea. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs current chart identifies Israel as requiring KDN (Ministry of Home Affairs) handling; do not infer ordinary visa-free entry or a self-service eVisa route.

The exact advance approval, travel-document acceptance, mission availability, purpose, duration, and admission conditions must be confirmed with Malaysian Immigration or the competent Malaysian mission before travel. The source does not establish a visa-on-arrival or ETA route.

This policy is limited to ordinary passport codes and does not establish diplomatic, official, residence, work, study, transit, refugee, alien-document, laissez-passer, certificate-of-identity, or other special-document treatment. MDAC is separate from visa/approval and does not establish entry permission.

policies.title: Maldives: foreign ordinary passports with tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Maldives Immigration grants the tourist visa on arrival to foreign tourists without visa pre-approval, subject to the separate Israeli-passport prohibition.
conditions: Applies only to foreign ordinary passports for tourism/short visitor travel. Maldives Immigration says tourist visas are granted on arrival and tourists do not require visa pre-approval.
A Traveller Declaration is mandatory within 96 hours before the arriving flight and is a free self-declaration. It is not an ETA or eVisa and does not replace arrival issuance.

Arrival requires an MRZ passport or travel document with at least one month validity (no extended-validity passports), a complete itinerary with confirmed return journey, prepaid registered accommodation and sufficient funds, or a pre-approved Maldives Immigration sponsorship visa; onward-entry requirements and applicable yellow-fever certification also apply.
Immigration officers determine admissibility at the port of entry. The reviewed current tourist-visa page does not state a fixed initial tourist-visa duration, so this candidate does not infer one.

Does not classify residence, work, business, meeting/conference, dependent, marriage, transit without clearing arrival immigration, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless, emergency or other special-document cases.

policies.title: Maldives: citizenship treatment
policies.summary: The destination's own ordinary-passport code is represented as citizenship rather than a foreign-entry visa result.
conditions: This represents a Maldivian citizen holding an ordinary Maldivian passport, not foreign visitor admission.
Does not classify dual-nationality, foreign residence, diplomatic, official, emergency or other document-specific circumstances.

policies.title: ECOWAS ordinary passports: visa-free entry to Mali under AES declaration
policies.summary: The signed AES declaration makes the AES space, including Mali, visa-free for nationals of ECOWAS member states. ECOWAS subsequently reported that the AES countries and ECOWAS agreed continued free movement pending a new agreement.
conditions: Applies only to nationals of the named ECOWAS State passport issuers holding ordinary passports for the normal visitor baseline.
ECOWAS nationals may enter, circulate, reside, establish and exit subject to national law; AES States retain the power to refuse entry to inadmissible ECOWAS nationals.

The policy does not decide employment, residence administration, commercial vehicle, diplomatic, official/service, refugee, laissez-passer, special-document, transit, crew, health, security or individual-admissibility treatment.

The live MFA assistant's residence/location-dependent ordinary-passport results conflict with this declaration for some ECOWAS nationalities (including Ghana and Cabo Verde). The signed AES declaration and later ECOWAS continuation statement are treated as controlling; the assistant is recorded as a material reconciliation risk.

policies.title: Mauritania: reciprocal-agreement ordinary-passport short-stay visa exemption
policies.summary: ANRPTS and the Foreign Affairs Ministry currently list reciprocal visa-suppression agreements that support ordinary-passport short visits for this 11-country foreign cohort. The ANRPTS list is used because it is the directly competent current visitor procedure; it is corroborated by the Foreign Affairs list.
conditions: The policy applies only to ordinary passports from the named reciprocal-agreement countries for a short visit. It does not extend Morocco, Syria, Yemen, the United Arab Emirates, Romania, Spain, Turkey, Brazil, China, Iran or India, whose listed agreements are limited to diplomatic, service or official passports.

ANRPTS's visitor procedure lists all eleven countries. A current APIM investment-information page lists only Algeria, Côte d’Ivoire, Gambia, Libya, Mali, Niger, Senegal and Tunisia, omitting Burkina Faso, Chad and Guinea-Bissau. The direct ANRPTS and Foreign Affairs schedules are given precedence; this unresolved official-source discrepancy requires periodic review.

The APIM summary says short stays are up to 90 days. Passport validity, border examination, security, health, purpose, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service, UN and other special-document rules remain outside this ordinary visitor policy.

policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: Mauritania electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: ANRPTS states that foreign visitors may request an online entry visa, that sticker visas have been replaced by online visas, and that a validated visa is printed and used for travel. Together with its exhaustive named reciprocal-exemption list, this directly supports an eVisa baseline for every other foreign ordinary passport in the catalog.
conditions: Complete the ANRPTS online request, await validation, print the resulting eVisa for boarding, and complete biometrics at the Mauritanian point of entry. The live service offers 30-day, 90-day and 360-day packages and says electronically issued visas allow entry via all international ports of entry.

The official procedure requires a passport valid for at least six months. ANRPTS says no entry visa may be obtained with a passport under six months' validity without prior authorization from competent authorities.

Airport and border-point processing named in the government procedures portal refers to the ANRPTS procedure and biometric completion. It does not describe a nationality-wide application for a visa on arrival, so this policy remains evisa.

This policy excludes the eleven named ordinary-passport reciprocal exemptions, Mauritanian citizenship, diplomatic/service/official and UN documents, work and residence visas, transit, long-stay and individual security or admissibility decisions.

application.label: ANRPTS Mauritania eVisa application
steps: Choose the applicable visa package in the official ANRPTS service and enter passport, traveler and trip information.
Submit the online visa request and await review by the competent authority.
Print the validated eVisa for boarding and complete biometric formalities on arrival at an international port of entry.

policies.title: Mauritius: listed national passports with no visa required
policies.summary: The current PIO country table expressly labels these nationalities 'No visa required'.
conditions: Ordinary/nationality result only: the country table does not establish diplomatic, official, service, special, laissez-passer, refugee, stateless, or other travel-document treatment.

A no-visa classification is not guaranteed admission. Every entrant still needs a recognized passport or travel document, return ticket, re-entry eligibility, funds, and confirmed accommodation or sponsorship.
No gainful activity without a valid residence permit. Residence/work, transit, crew, medical, social/religious, marriage, study, and case-specific entry rules remain separate.

policies.title: Mauritius: listed national passports with a 60-day visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current PIO country table expressly provides a visa for sixty days on arrival to these nationalities.
conditions: Ordinary/nationality result only, for the table's stated 60-day visa-on-arrival period; the Immigration Officer determines admission and the length of any particular visit.
Taiwan is a special document case: its passport is generally listed as unrecognized, but PIO specifically says Taiwan passport holders may receive a 60-day visa on arrival.
Every entrant must meet the current passport/document, return-ticket, re-entry, funds, and accommodation/sponsorship requirements; no gainful activity is permitted without a residence permit.
Does not classify diplomatic, official, service, special, laissez-passer, refugee, stateless, residence, work, crew, transit, medical, social/religious, marriage, study, or case-specific exceptions.

policies.title: Mauritius: listed national passports with a two-week visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current PIO country table expressly provides a visa for two weeks on arrival to these nationalities.
conditions: Ordinary/nationality result only, for the table's stated two-week visa-on-arrival period; it does not establish a 60-day entitlement.
The Immigration Officer makes the final admission decision and decides the length of a particular visit after examination at entry.
Every entrant must meet the current passport/document, return-ticket, re-entry, funds, and accommodation/sponsorship requirements; no gainful activity is permitted without a residence permit.
Does not classify diplomatic, official, service, special, laissez-passer, refugee, stateless, residence, work, crew, transit, medical, social/religious, marriage, study, or case-specific exceptions.

policies.title: Mauritius: listed national passports requiring a visa before travel
policies.summary: The current PIO table requires a visa before travel for these nationalities, and PIO separately gives the same rule for Guyana.
conditions: Ordinary/nationality result only. Apply through a Mauritian diplomatic or consular representative, Air Mauritius where applicable, or PIO's stated fallback channel; wait for the decision before travel.
PIO's current published routes are consular/representative, Air Mauritius office, or the stated email fallback. No nationality-wide electronic-visa route is established by the reviewed sources.

A visa permits travel to a port of entry but does not guarantee admission; all passport/document, purpose, return-ticket, re-entry, funds, accommodation, and immigration-examination requirements still apply.
Does not override diplomatic, official, service, special, laissez-passer, refugee, stateless, residence, work, crew, transit, medical, social/religious, marriage, study, or case-specific exceptions.

application.label: Mauritius PIO visa application instructions
application.processingTime: As far as practicable, 12 working days after complete submission.
steps: Apply through the stated Mauritian diplomatic/consular, Air Mauritius, or PIO fallback route.
Submit the completed form, passport copy, travel, funds, accommodation, residence, and purpose documents required for the case.
Wait for the application outcome before travelling to Mauritius.

policies.title: Mexican nationals: outside foreign visitor visa scope
policies.summary: INM's nationality lists regulate foreign nationals' visitor admission, not Mexican citizens.
conditions: This citizenship classification does not establish document requirements for an individual Mexican national, dual national, carrier, or border route.
It does not determine treatment when a dual Mexican national presents another country's ordinary passport.

policies.title: INM-listed ordinary passports: visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: The listed nationalities may seek admission as visitors without permission to undertake remunerated activities without obtaining a Mexican visa in advance.
conditions: This policy is for a visitor without permission to undertake remunerated activities, including tourism; it does not grant residence, work authorization, or a right to admission.

INM may verify passport or internationally valid identity-and-travel document, travel purpose, accommodation or itinerary, means of subsistence, departure transport, and other relevant information at migration review.
The visitor period is not a guaranteed 180 days: INM authorizes the period at entry, and the visa-required guidance says the non-resident visitor route may not exceed 180 days.
For a land entry, INM requires the applicable completed FMM; international-airport FMM handling is generated through migration control.

This normalization is limited to ordinary national passports. It does not establish rules for residence cards, diplomatic or official documents, refugees, stateless persons, alien travel documents, or other special documents.

policies.title: Russia, Türkiye, and Ukraine: SAE electronic authorization for air visitors
policies.summary: Russian, Turkish, and Ukrainian ordinary passport holders may obtain the SAE pre-travel electronic authorization to fly to Mexico as non-remunerated visitors, instead of first obtaining a Mexican visa.
conditions: SAE is an air-only pre-travel authorization for a visitor without permission for remunerated activities; travel by land or sea requires a Mexican visa under INM's current SAE guidance.

The traveller needs a valid passport, an approved authorization, a participating airline, and a printed authorization for airline and migration checks. Approval does not guarantee admission or the period authorized at entry.

The INM central SAE page says the authorization is valid for 30 days and one entry. A current Mexican consular post in Milan instead states 180 days and one entry; the validity conflict is recorded here and the central INM statement is used operationally pending clarification.

A valid visa of Canada, Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom, or a Schengen country, or permanent residence in the listed countries (including Chile, Colombia, and Peru), is a separate alternative to both Mexican visa and SAE for a visa-required national.
This policy does not establish residence, remunerated activity, ordinary visa-free entry, or a rule for diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, or other special travel documents.

application.label: INM Sistema de Autorización Electrónica
steps: Complete the INM electronic-authorization request with the valid ordinary passport.
Print the approved authorization before presenting at the participating airline's check-in counter.
Present the authorization and passport for Mexican migration inspection on arrival by air.

policies.title: Brazil: electronic visa for air visitors
policies.summary: From 5 February 2026, Brazilian ordinary passport holders may use Mexico's electronic visitor-visa route for a non-remunerated stay of less than 180 days when entering exclusively by air.
conditions: Mexico's Rio consular guidance calls this route a visa electrónica. It is normalized as eVisa rather than ETA because approval produces a visa and the official application charges a visa fee.
The route is exclusively by air, for fewer than 180 days and without remunerated activities. It is valid for one entry; the Rio source states 180 days' authorization validity.
A Brazilian transit traveller using this route must obtain a new electronic visa each time the traveller disembarks at a Mexican airport.
A residence visa, multiple-entry visa, ten-year visa, land or sea entry, remunerated activity, or other purpose requires the applicable separate Mexican process.
Electronic authorization does not guarantee admission; Mexican migration authorities decide admission and the authorized visitor period at the point of entry.

application.label: Mexico electronic visa application for Brazilian travellers
steps: Complete the electronic visa form using the details from the valid Brazilian passport.
Upload the required face photograph and passport data-page image, then pay the application fee.
Receive the electronic visa before travel and present it with the same passport for the air journey and migration inspection.

policies.title: INM-listed ordinary passports: visitor visa required
policies.summary: The listed nationalities require a Mexican visa for travel as a non-remunerated visitor unless the traveller holds a specifically listed alternative document or qualifies for another documented exception.
conditions: INM says the listed nationalities must obtain the visa corresponding to their condition of stay at a Mexican consulate; for tourism, business, or other non-remunerated activity this is visitor without permission for remunerated activities.

A valid and current visa of Canada, Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom, or a Schengen country is an alternative to a Mexican visa. Permanent residence in Canada, the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom, a Schengen country, Chile, Colombia, or Peru is another alternative.

An ABTC approved by Mexico is an alternative only for air entry and business travel. Aircraft crew certification and a seafarer's book for qualifying crew are separate document-specific alternatives; an air-arriving seafarer also needs proof of enrolment, vessel data, and the Mexican port.

These alternatives do not create nationality-wide visa-free status and do not establish residence, paid work, or admission. The ordinary visitor stay cannot exceed 180 days absent residence or a migration process.
This policy concerns ordinary national passports only. It does not establish a rule for diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, alien, or other special travel documents.

policies.title: Mongolia: ordinary passports exempt under ongoing bilateral or unilateral rules
policies.summary: The current Consular Department schedule expressly records these ordinary/all-passport visa exemptions, with the stated stay periods.
conditions: The source records nationality-specific stays: PH 21 days; HK 14; KZ, US, MO, BY, BR, AR, CL, EC, PE, PY and CO 90; the remaining listed nationalities 30 days.

This is an ordinary-passport visitor result. It excludes Ukraine’s official-invitation condition, diplomatic/official/service agreements, UN laissez-passer cases, work, residence, transit, extensions and admission decisions.
The Consular Department schedule identifies Colombia as ordinary passports only; other listed entries say all passports, but this candidate is limited to ordinary passports.

policies.title: Mongolia: temporary 2026 34-country tourist exemption
policies.summary: Mongolia’s Government and Immigration Agency currently exempt this 34-country cohort from tourist visa requirements for stays up to 30 days in 2026.
conditions: Valid only for tourism and up to 30 days, in the 2026 programme. It should not be carried forward after 31 December 2026 without a new official measure.
This temporary exemption does not establish work, residence, study, long stay, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or case-specific admission rights.
Current Immigration material also lists these countries for border tourist-visa issuance; visa-free tourism is the easier applicable route during this programme.

policies.title: Mongolia: Republic of Korea temporary tourism exemption
policies.summary: The current Consular Department schedule records a 90-day all-passport visa exemption for Korean tourism through 31 December 2026.
conditions: Tourism purpose only, up to 90 days. The time limit is explicit and requires renewed confirmation after 31 December 2026.
It does not decide work, residence, study, diplomatic, official, service, transit, crew, special-document or individual admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Mongolia: Indian ordinary passport tourist visa at border without prior visa permit
policies.summary: The Immigration Agency’s current exhaustive border list names India among nationalities to which tourist visas may be issued at the international border without visa permit.
conditions: This is a tourist visa issued at the international border without a prior visa permit, so it is classified as visa on arrival rather than eVisa or visa-free.
The official eVisa country list also names India, but the border-issued tourist route is the easier applicable route for the baseline taxonomy.

It does not establish a visa-free right or govern work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/service, special-document, fee, port, duration, extension, security or individual-admissibility questions.

policies.title: Mongolia: named ordinary passports eligible for eVisa
policies.summary: The Immigration Agency’s current exhaustive eVisa-country list names these countries; after removing easier visa-free and Indian border-visa routes, their baseline visitor route is eVisa.
conditions: Apply electronically before travel through Mongolia’s official eVisa service; this is a visa, not an ETA or a visa on arrival.
The portal requires a passport/relevant substitute valid at least 180 days before intended travel; the eVisa is non-extendable and non-convertible.

Carry the eVisa copy and the passport used in the application. Border biometrics are mandatory; admission remains discretionary. The inviting person, accommodation provider or host entity must register the foreign national online within 48 hours after arrival.

This finding is limited to the named country list and ordinary visitor entry. It does not establish work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien-document, group-tour, invitation or port-specific rights.
The current eVisa portal contains a legacy non-navigable country-list section; this classification relies on the Immigration Agency’s current expressly titled eVisa eligibility list.

application.label: Mongolia electronic visa application
steps: Apply online through the official eVisa system.
Provide accurate application information and pay the non-refundable visa fee.
Carry the issued eVisa copy and the same passport to border control.

policies.title: Morocco: live-selector ordinary-passport visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: For these ordinary-passport tourist inputs with no additional visa and ordinary residence in the nationality country, the current Accès Maroc service returns its visa-exempt outcome, not an AEVM or visa process.
conditions: This is a current ordinary-passport tourist selector result with country of usual residence set to the nationality country and no additional visa. It does not replace different rules for residence elsewhere, a third-country visa, another purpose, event participation, diplomatic/official/special documents, refugees, stateless persons or other travel documents.

Foreign visitors remain subject to a recognized valid travel document, border examination, proof of means and purpose, and any visa where required under Law 02-03. The exemption does not guarantee admission.

The live selector was rechecked on 21 August 2026 and returns exemption for Azerbaijan, whereas the eVisa terms PDF still names Azerbaijan in Category A. The live individualized result is used, but this unresolved official-source disagreement requires maintainer confirmation.

policies.title: Morocco: ordinary-passport visitor AEVM
policies.summary: The current Accès Maroc nationality reference flags this cohort for authorization, and the portal directs it to the electronic travel-authorization process rather than visa exemption or eVisa.
conditions: AEVM is a pre-travel electronic authorization, normalized as eta. The guide separately distinguishes visa exemption, consular visa, AEVM and eVisa outcomes.

The public selector depends on nationality, ordinary passport, country of usual residence, additional visa, purpose and date of birth; this policy records only the observed nationality baseline without a qualifying third-country status.

The AEVM guide requires an account, personal/passport/travel and accommodation/financing information, supporting documents, validation and an approved downloadable authorization. It is not a visa-free route and does not guarantee admission.
Work, residence, family, transit, event, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless and special-document routes are outside this policy.

application.label: Accès Maroc electronic travel authorization service
steps: Use the official eligibility form with nationality, ordinary passport, residence, any additional visa, purpose and date of birth.
If routed to AEVM, register or authenticate, complete the personal, passport and travel information, attach the required documents and validate the request.
Follow the file in the portal and download the authorization if approved before travel.

policies.title: Morocco: nationality-wide ordinary-passport eVisa
policies.summary: The current Accès Maroc service routes this named ordinary-passport tourist cohort to an eVisa without a residence permit or third-country visa condition.
conditions: The eVisa terms describe an online, single-entry visa for tourism or business, valid up to 180 days from issue for a stay not exceeding 30 days. Only ordinary passports may use it.
The application needs a passport valid at least 90 days at application, and the portal says it may be issued in 24 working hours (express) or 72 working hours (standard) for complete applications.

At the border, the eVisa holder must present the eVisa and passport and may be asked for a return ticket, means of at least EUR 70 per day and repatriation/medical insurance. Admission remains discretionary.

The eVisa terms also offer conditional routes based on an eligible residence permit or a valid multiple-entry third-country visa. Those conditions do not expand this nationality-only policy. The terms PDF names Azerbaijan as Category A but the live selector currently exempts it; Azerbaijan is therefore not included here.

application.label: Accès Maroc eVisa service
application.processingTime: The official eVisa terms state 24 working hours for express and 72 working hours for standard processing of complete applications.
steps: Check eligibility in the official Accès Maroc form and select the eVisa process.
Enter the application and attach the passport copy, photograph and purpose-specific supporting documents; validate and pay the request.
Track the file in Accès Maroc, download the approved eVisa, and present it at boarding and the Moroccan border.

policies.title: Morocco: ordinary-passport visitor consular visa baseline
policies.summary: For these ordinary-passport tourist inputs with usual residence in the nationality country and no additional visa, the live Accès Maroc service returns its visa-required outcome rather than exemption, AEVM or eVisa.
conditions: The portal's visa outcome means a Moroccan visa application is required. The official AEVM guide distinguishes this from the electronic travel authorization and eVisa outcomes, and says the visa application is lodged at the consular post.

This does not rule out the separately documented conditional eVisa paths for a traveler who holds a qualifying residence permit or an eligible valid multiple-entry third-country visa; those are not nationality-only routes.

Law 02-03 requires foreign arrivals to present a valid recognized travel document and, where applicable, an administrative visa. Visa possession does not remove border examination, evidence-of-stay or refusal risk.
This baseline excludes work, residence, family, transit, event, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless and special-document treatment.

policies.title: Mozambique: longstanding all-passport visa-exemption partners
policies.summary: Both the live immigration portal and the Foreign Ministry identify these nationalities as exempt from a visa for qualifying short visits.
conditions: The live portal permits the stated ordinary-passport tourist or business stay without an eTA or eVisa: 90 days for Botswana and Tanzania, and 30 days for the other listed nationalities.
The Foreign Ministry describes these as all-passport bilateral visa-suppression agreements.

Ordinary-passport short tourism or business visits only; work, residence, study, crew, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency and other special-document cases are outside this policy.
Admission remains subject to passport validity, travel-purpose, supporting-document, health, security and border-control requirements; an approval or exemption does not guarantee entry.

policies.title: Mozambique: additional current ordinary-passport visa exemptions
policies.summary: The live immigration portal lists these ordinary or all-passport nationalities as visa-exempt for qualifying short tourist or business visits.
conditions: The live portal lists 30 days for Angola, Cabo Verde, Lesotho, Namibia, São Tomé and Príncipe, Seychelles and Uganda, and 90 days for Kenya and Rwanda.

The Foreign Ministry's separate current entry-visas page still publishes only eight longstanding all-passport agreements and omits this expanded cohort. The live National Immigration Service eligibility table is treated as the current operational rule, but this official-source discrepancy warrants rechecking.

Ordinary-passport short tourism or business visits only; work, residence, study, crew, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency and other special-document cases are outside this policy.
Admission remains subject to passport validity, travel-purpose, supporting-document, health, security and border-control requirements; an approval or exemption does not guarantee entry.

policies.title: Mozambique: eTA required before travel
policies.summary: The live immigration portal requires these nationalities to obtain an electronic travel authorisation before qualifying short tourist or business travel.
conditions: The eTA permits up to 30 days for tourist or business purposes and applies to all passport types in the published table; this policy models the ordinary-passport component.
The applicant must apply online, pay the fee and carry the approved preliminary eTA PDF for boarding and arrival.
An eVisa is needed instead if the permitted ETA duration or purpose does not cover the trip.

Ordinary-passport short tourism or business visits only; work, residence, study, crew, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency and other special-document cases are outside this policy.
Admission remains subject to passport validity, travel-purpose, supporting-document, health, security and border-control requirements; an approval or exemption does not guarantee entry.

application.label: Start from Mozambique's official National Immigration Service eVisa and eTA portal
steps: Confirm the passport nationality, intended purpose and permitted stay in the official eligibility table.
Complete the linked online application, upload the requested documents and pay the applicable fee.
If approved, download and print the preliminary eVisa or eTA PDF and carry it for boarding and arrival.

policies.title: Mozambique: advance electronic visa route
policies.summary: The live immigration portal includes these ordinary-passport nationalities in Mozambique's electronic-visa scheme for qualifying visits.
conditions: The tourist eVisa covers tourism, holidays or vacations of 90 days or less; other published electronic-visa purposes have their own requirements.
The applicant must apply and pay online before travel, then carry the approved preliminary eVisa PDF for boarding and arrival.
The physical visa may be finalized at the border, but prior electronic approval is mandatory, so this is normalized as eVisa rather than visa on arrival.

Ordinary-passport short tourism or business visits only; work, residence, study, crew, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency and other special-document cases are outside this policy.
Admission remains subject to passport validity, travel-purpose, supporting-document, health, security and border-control requirements; an approval or exemption does not guarantee entry.

application.label: Start from Mozambique's official National Immigration Service eVisa and eTA portal
steps: Confirm the passport nationality, intended purpose and permitted stay in the official eligibility table.
